name: 6883-sonnet550-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: poisson (OPEN loop), a two-point rate sweep at 10 then 30 requests/s, each bounded at 1200 requests / 900 s safety, warmup the first 30% by completion. 10 req/s is the scored point; 30 req/s is a second, deeper point on the same curve, because this workload's latencies are load-dependent and one point cannot show that.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, streaming. 550 prompt tokens (a 200-token shared prefix plus 350 per request) and exactly 150 output tokens, min = max on both.
purpose: A live support-reply assistant on an eight-billion-parameter model, answering 550-token shared-prefix prompts at 10-30 requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.5.3.post1-era engine args: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do
# not add keys from a later vLLM. Values this engine resolves to are written out so they cannot
# drift; block-size, kv-cache-dtype, enable-prefix-caching and enforce-eager are left at default.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 512
disable-log-requests: true
max-num-seqs: 256
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 4096
